Name: Furniture Placement Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a very small mod, by request, that has two toggleable options:

[list]
[*][b]Allow Overlap[/b] - lets you place furniture overlapping with other furniture (e.g. placing a rug underneath an already placed table) - default [b]true[/b]
[*][b]Pickup If Under[/b] - lets you pickup rugs from underneath other furniture (this is the vanilla behaviour) - default [b]false[/b]
[/list]
You can change either of these options in GMCM or by editing the config file created after running the game.

This video shows the difference in behaviour:

[youtube]XTbNiVm_xKE[/youtube]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
